# 1,000.00 USD of income paid into A at −500.00, stating A's owed cost basis,
# and valued at the 1.40 of the day throughout: 1,400.00, the figure GnuCash's
# own register writes.
#
# The 500.00 it repays cost 1.35, 675.00, and the 500.00 it brings in came at
# 1.40, 700.00, so the split is worth 1,375.00 as a disposal and an arrival.
# Valued at 1,400.00, the 25.00 the repayment lost would sit in the held cost
# basis, costing the 500.00 at 1.45, and no `$residual$` split would state it.
# So it is refused, as a sale valued at anything but what its cost basis cost
# is, and the refusal states the figure.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "1,000.00 USD of income paid into A, valued at the day's rate"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD A 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "1400.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000001"
	Income:Consulting -1400.00 CAD
